hypothesis: Reprogramming of somatic cells to a pluripotent state
prediction: Introduction of the four known stem cell regulators (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) into somatic cells will induce pluripotency in a subset of cells
measurement_method: Assay for pluripotency markers (e.g. SSEA-1, SSEA-3, SSEA-4, TRA-1-60, TRA-1-81) and ability to differentiate into multiple cell types
falsification_condition: If less than 1% of treated somatic cells exhibit pluripotency markers and/or fail to differentiate into multiple cell types, the prediction is falsified
